fix.s: In the formal sense under Article 74, appointments such as the Attorney General and State Governors are made by the President on the advice of the Council of Ministers headed by the:
fix.x: Under Article 74 the President acts on the aid and advice of the Council of Ministers headed by the Prime Minister, so appointments like the Attorney General and Governors are formally made on that advice. Judges are different: the President appoints them after consultation with the CJI-led collegium.
